The system recognises the document type,: The system recognises the document type, extracts its fields and checks the results. Uncertain types and values require review.
The reader preserves paragraphs, tables: The reader preserves paragraphs, tables and cell references. GPT proposes facts from the readable content. Images, unsupported structures and missing formula results remain visible gaps; they are not silently treated as read.
PDF documents and Word, Excel, TXT or CS: PDF documents and Word, Excel, TXT or CSV files use different extraction paths. Automatic processing supports a mixed package; Word, Excel, TXT and CSV always need GPT extraction.
PDF documents use the recognised type's: PDF documents use the recognised type's recommended path. Word, Excel, TXT and CSV use GPT extraction followed by JEV support checks. Recommended for mixed document packages.
For PDF documents only: JEV selects cand: For PDF documents only: JEV selects candidate values where the type supports it; other PDF types use GPT and JEV. A package containing Word, Excel, TXT or CSV cannot start on this path. Choose Automatic, GPT + JEV or GPT only for those files.
GPT extracts values and JEV assesses the: GPT extracts values and JEV assesses their support. PDF documents use their type's fields; Word, Excel, TXT and CSV produce facts linked to their source structure.
GPT extracts values without JEV calls. P: GPT extracts values without JEV calls. PDF documents also use GPT type recognition. Word, Excel, TXT and CSV retain source references and reading gaps. Source checks do not replace human review.
Azure text recognition applies only to P: Azure text recognition applies only to PDF documents. It does not read images embedded in Word or Excel files.
A weak PDF scan may use Azure recognitio: A weak PDF scan may use Azure recognition within its budget. Word, Excel, TXT and CSV are unaffected.
Azure recognition is disabled. PDF docum: Azure recognition is disabled. PDF documents can still use local text recognition; unread images in Word or Excel remain visible gaps.
